Title: Public Preview: Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) 21

Body.Content:
Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) is an AI assistant to help with writing, editing, and fixing T-SQL queries using natural language. Copilot in SSMS grounds its responses in database context, providing responses customized to your environment. Copilot in SSMS helps answer questions about database administration and maintenance, implementation and configuration, and more for SQL databases on-premises and in the cloud. 

Learn more.
